subject: Co-sell listing: seller entity evidence & invoice routing for CloudBridge (AWS/Azure/GCP)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Integration <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sell listing: seller entity evidence & invoice routing for CloudBridge (AWS/Azure/GCP)

Hi team / Sam,

Following up on the co-sell onboarding questionnaire: CloudBridge is ready to go live on AWS/Azure/GCP but we hit a snag on invoicing and tax evidence required by each marketplace. They specifically asked: who will be the merchant-of-record (MOR) per marketplace, which legal entity will issue invoices, and whether Redwood should provide a W-9 or W-8BEN for US tax purposes.

Quick summary of the ask from CloudBridge AP: they need an invoice path for each marketplace (AWS MOR vs reseller vs marketplace-direct), a copy of Redwood's tax document (W-9 if US entity; W-8 if foreign withholding applies), and a short table that maps marketplace -> billing entity -> expected invoice remit-to and tax form.

Can Marcus and Laura confirm the recommended routing for AWS / Azure / GCP (we've historically taken MOR on AWS Marketplace for hosted offers, but co-sell/reseller setups can be different). Vanessa, can you confirm if Redwood can sign an EU VAT reverse-charge attestation for CloudBridge when applicable?

Sam — adding you here so AP can see the proposed plan and confirm the remit email and any PO/contract reference CloudBridge needs on the invoices.

Next steps I propose:
- Marcus to draft the mapping table for AWS/Azure/GCP
- Laura to confirm tax form (W-9 vs W-8) and attach the signed doc
- Vanessa to confirm VAT reverse-charge/registry handling for EU customers if CloudBridge will resell to EU customers

Thanks — trying to get this squared before the listing goes live next week.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
(attachment stub: CloudBridge_onboarding_checklist.xlsx)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell listing: seller entity evidence & invoice routing for CloudBridge (AWS/Azure/GCP)

On Sun, 25 Jul 2027 at 09:12, Jordan Blake wrote:
> Following up on the co-sell onboarding questionnaire: CloudBridge is ready to go live on AWS/Azure/GCP but we hit a snag on invoicing and tax evidence required by each marketplace.

Short answers: yes on VAT reverse-charge where applicable, and Redwood can provide a W-9 (we're a US payee) for CloudBridge to capture on their AP side. Important nuance: for AWS we typically operate as MOR for our "hosted" marketplace listing, which means Redwood issues the invoice and collects payment (AWS then remits per their settlement terms). For co-sell or reseller paths (where CloudBridge routes through reseller or partner-managed offers), the invoice path may need to be split or reissued based on the contract.

Marcus — can you provide the flattened table (marketplace / expected MOR / invoice issuer / remit-to email / required tax form) please? I'll also attach the signed W-9 and a short note on VAT handling (EU reverse charge mechanics and what evidence CloudBridge will need from its EU customers).

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Marketplace Ops, Redwood Inference
(attachment stub: Redwood_W-9_signed.pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell listing: seller entity evidence & invoice routing for CloudBridge (AWS/Azure/GCP)

Thanks — I put together the routing matrix below (attached as an XLSX for AP). Short version here inline: 

Marketplace -> MOR -> Invoice issuer -> Remit-to -> Tax form
- AWS (standard hosted offer) -> Redwood (US entity) -> Redwood -> ap@redwood.com -> W-9
- AWS (co-sell/reseller offer via CloudBridge) -> CloudBridge (reseller entity) -> CloudBridge -> ap@cloudbridge.io -> CloudBridge must provide their local tax evidence (VAT/EORI/W8/W9 as applicable)
- Azure Marketplace (transactable offer) -> Microsoft (MOR) -> Microsoft issues invoice to buyer and bills us in settlement -> Microsoft (buyer-facing invoice), Redwood receives settlement; Redwood to provide W-9 to Microsoft if requested -> Remit from Microsoft to Redwood per MS schedule
- GCP Marketplace (if marketplace-hosted) -> Google (MOR) -> Google issues invoice -> Google remits to Redwood; tax treatment follows Google’s marketplace terms; Redwood provides W-9 to Google if requested

Attachment: CloudBridge_MOR_matrix.xlsx (contains full invoice lines, PO fields, and suggested invoice remarks). Laura — can you confirm that Redwood_W-9_signed.pdf is the correct form and help with the DocuSign link if CloudBridge needs an executed copy with a company seal?

Marcus Lin
Senior Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
(attachment stub: CloudBridge_MOR_matrix.xlsx)

From: Sam Park <sam.park@cloudbridge.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell listing: seller entity evidence & invoice routing for CloudBridge (AWS/Azure/GCP)

Thanks Jordan/Vanessa/Marcus — this is helpful. A couple of follow ups from our AP team: 
1) We received the Redwood_W-9_signed.pdf — can you confirm the EIN shown is the legal entity that will act as MOR for the AWS hosted offer? Our finance policy requires matching EIN on the invoice to the W-9.
2) For the reseller path on AWS, CloudBridge will be the invoice issuer — can Redwood provide an indemnity note we can append to our reseller agreement that clarifies VAT handling for EU customers (reverse-charge acknowledgement)?
3) Please confirm the remit-to email we should expect invoices from for each path (you listed ap@redwood.com and ap@cloudbridge.io). We will route automatically but want the exact expected invoice-from addresses for our parsing rules.

Once we have the EIN confirmation and the brief indemnity language, AP will accept the invoice routing and proceed with listing activation. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Sam
CloudBridge, Head of Finance Ops
(attachment stub: CloudBridge_PO_template.docx)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

On Wed, 28 Jul 2027 at 16:45, Sam Park wrote:
> 1) We received the Redwood_W-9_signed.pdf — can you confirm the EIN shown is the legal entity that will act as MOR for the AWS hosted offer?

Sam — confirmed: the EIN on Redwood_W-9_signed.pdf matches the Redwood US operating entity that will be MOR on the AWS hosted offer. Laura will attach a notarized copy to the Drive folder for your records.

> 2) For the reseller path on AWS, CloudBridge will be the invoice issuer — can Redwood provide an indemnity note we can append to our reseller agreement that clarifies VAT handling for EU customers (reverse-charge acknowledgement)?

Vanessa will draft the short indemnity paragraph (1–2 sentences) and circulate for signature.

> 3) Please confirm the remit-to email we should expect invoices from for each path

Expect:
- Hosted AWS offer (Redwood MOR): invoices from billing@redwood-invoices.com -> remit ap@redwood.com
- Reseller/co-sell AWS offer (CloudBridge issuer): invoices from ap@cloudbridge.io -> remit ap@cloudbridge.io
- Azure Marketplace transactable: invoice notifications from no-reply@microsoft.com (buyer invoice) and settlement remits will show as settlement@partner.microsoft.com
- GCP Marketplace: invoices from billing@google.com -> remits to settlement@google.com with settlement lines to Redwood

I'll drop the indemnity draft this afternoon and upload the notarized W-9 to the Drive link in the related_links above. Once Sam confirms, we can mark this thread closed and signal Marketplace to flip the listing switch.

Thanks — Jordan
